Submitting your AI tool — FAQ
Is it free to submit an AI tool?+

Yes. Submitting your AI tool to ToolScout is completely free, and a free listing stays in the directory at no cost. Optional paid Boost and Featured placements are available if you want extra visibility, but they are never required.
How long does it take to get listed?+

Every submission is reviewed by a human. Free listings take a week or more to review; Boost and Featured submissions are fast-tracked and reviewed within 24 to 48 hours. You'll get an email the moment your tool is approved and live on the site.
What do I get when my AI tool is listed?+

A dedicated tool page with your description, category tags, pricing, and a screenshot; placement in the matching category and pricing feeds; and an embeddable "Featured on ToolScout" badge you can add to your own site.
